# MOX Fuel Properties vs Pu Content

Thermal conductivity and density of (U1-x,Pux)O2 mixed oxide fuel as a function of plutonium fraction x:

| Pu fraction x | Density (g/cm^3) | TC 1000 K (W/(m K)) | Lattice (angstrom) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | 10.97 | 3.2 | 5.470 |
| 0.05 | 10.96 | 2.8 | 5.464 |
| 0.08 | 10.95 | 2.5 | 5.460 |
| 0.15 | 10.92 | 2.1 | 5.450 |
| 0.20 | 10.89 | 1.8 | 5.443 |
| 0.30 | 10.83 | 1.5 | 5.428 |

The lattice parameter decreases linearly with Pu content.
